Viewports: **1440×900** (`desktop-1440`) and **1180×820** (`narrow-1180`).

## Committed files

Mock Playwright (`web/e2e/m4-8-evidence.spec.ts`) commits the core viewports on the tip. Local RC (`web/e2e/local-rc/m4-8-*.spec.ts`) regenerates the same filenames against the real API.

**Committed on tip (22 PNGs):** list, list-filtered, kanban, gantt, marcos, marcos-risk, inspector-assigned, inspector-start-block, deliverable-refs, authz-forbidden — each at 1440×900 and 1180×820.

**Local RC CI extras (not committed; regenerated by `pnpm local-rc:e2e`):** `gantt-date-*`, `authz-search-empty-*`, `authz-viewer-preview-*`. Absence from git is not a missing requirement — Playwright still captures them in CI artifacts.
